description: Runs pytest and returns structured test results (passed, failed, errors, skipped, failures).

collectOnly.description: Only collect tests, do not run them (--collect-only)

configFile.description: Path to pytest config file (-c FILE)

env.description: Additional environment variables for the pytest process, merged over the parent environment (e.g. {"PYTHONPATH": "src"} for src-layout projects)

extraArgs.description: Additional pytest CLI arguments passed through verbatim (e.g. ["-p", "no:logfire"] to disable a broken plugin). Each element is validated for control characters.

keyword.description: Keyword expression for test filtering (-k EXPR)

lastFailed.description: Re-run only tests that failed last time (--lf)

noCapture.description: Disable stdout/stderr capturing, useful for print-debugging (-s)

parallel.description: Number of parallel workers for pytest-xdist (-n NUM, 0=auto)

pythonPath.description: Python interpreter path to use (overrides venv/PATH detection)

targets.description: Test files or directories to run (default: auto-discover)

name: pytest

errorOutput.description: Tail of the raw pytest output explaining why the run produced no test results (e.g. collection error, ModuleNotFoundError, broken plugin); only present when the run failed with no parseable test results

exitCode.description: pytest exit code; only present when the run failed with no parseable test results

failedTests.description: Names of failed tests (set in compact output)

warnings.description: Count of warnings from pytest warnings summary

title: pytest
